tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire serialisation format

The project's current recorded decision is to use CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation) as the wire serialisation format. The rationale recorded for this decision is CBOR's greater standardisation maturity and fewer version-compatibility issues.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It states that the project's current recorded decision is CBOR as the wire serialisation format, with the recorded rationale of more mature standardisation and fewer version-compatibility issues.

The project memory has two serialisation decisions. MessagePack was recorded first, and CBOR replaced it a few minutes later. I used only CBOR and left MessagePack out of the file, as you asked.

The code still uses MessagePack in `render/msgpack.go` and `binding/msgpack.go`. I didn't treat that as a recorded decision, so the doc doesn't mention it. The decision to move to CBOR hasn't been implemented yet.
